entries.german:
Marquard von Mödling überträgt auf den Abt und Convent des Klosters zu Hohenfurt alle seine Rechte an dem Dorfe Buggaus.

Ego Marquardus dictus Metlyn tenore presencium publice recognosco, quod omne jus, quod hactenus vna cum heredibus meis in villa Bukauxs habui, quam a nobili domina Anna de Lypa cum omnibus suis pertinenciis iusto empcionis tytulo comparaui, prout in littera super hoc coufecta plenius continetur, idem ius in religiosos viros dominos abbatem et conuentum monasterii Altiuadensis presentibus transfero et transfundo pretacto juri cum heredibus meis penitus renuncians et omnino. In cuius rei robur et euidens testimonium sigillum meum presentibus est appensum et in testimonium lucidius sigilla dominorum meorum nobilium Petri et Johannis de Rosenberg necnon famosorum clientum Nicolai de Malotyn Nicolay de Rzebnowytz presentibus sunt appensa. Datum anno domini millesimo trecentesimo septuagesimo septimo die assumpcionis beate Marie virginis gloriose.

Siegel: Vier kleine, an Pergamentstreifen hängende Siegel a und d in weissem, b und c in rothem Wachs. a) Ein Helm, dessen Zierde eine Frauengestalt. Vergl. CXII. d. Auf der rechten Seite überdies ein Baum (?) . - + S . Marqvard . D. [Liczew?]. b) und c) Die bekannten kleinen Siegel Peter's und Johann's v. R. d) Ein Helm, dessen Zierde in einer menschlichen nicht näher bestimmbaren Gestalt besteht. - + S . Nicolai . D . Malotin . . . e) Das Siegel des Rzebnowitzer's fehlt.
entries.english:
Marquard von Mödling transfers to the abbot and convent of Hohenfurt Abbey all his rights in the village of Buggaus.

I, Marquard called Metlyn, publicly acknowledge by this document that I transfer and convey to the religious lords, the abbot and convent of the monastery of Hohenfurt, all the right that I have hitherto held, together with my heirs, in the village called Bukauxs, which I acquired by lawful purchase from the noble lady Anna de Lypa with all its appurtenances, as is more fully contained in the charter made concerning this matter. I wholly and entirely renounce this right, together with my heirs. In confirmation and clear testimony of this matter my seal is attached; for clearer testimony, the seals of my lords, the noble Peter and Hans von Rosenberg, and of the well-known squires Nicolaus de Malotyn and Nicolaus de Rzebnowytz are also attached. Given in the year of the Lord 1377, on the feast of the Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary.

Four small seals hang from parchment strips, a and d in white wax, b and c in red. Seal a shows a helmet with a woman as its crest; compare no. CXII. On its right side there is also a tree (?). Inscription: ‘S. Marqvard. D. [Liczew?].’ Seals b and c are the familiar small seals of Peter and Hans von Rosenberg. Seal d shows a helmet with an indistinct human figure as its crest; inscription: ‘S. Nicolai. D. Malotin…’. The seal of the man from Rzebnowitz is missing.
